item.title: SHOT Show 26 – Badger Ordnance C1 Charging Handle
item.description: Badger Ordnance recently introduced an updated, 4th generation version of their C1 Charging Handle for AR pattern rifles. Machined from a 7075 forging and finished in Type III hardcoat anodizing, it features ambidextrous operation. Offered in Black or Tan, there are versions for AR-10, AR-15, and MCX platforms.

item.title: NP Aerospace and ITEN Defense Form Strategic Partnership
item.description: NP Aerospace, the global armour manufacturer and vehicle integrator, has formed a strategic partnership with ITEN Defense, a US-based specialist in opaque and transparent armour technologies.
